question: Which group of beneficial bacteria is commonly used in fermented dairy products?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lactobacillus acidophilus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lactobacillus acidophilus** is a type of beneficial bacteria commonly used in fermented dairy products.
 
• These bacteria help in the fermentation process by converting lactose into lactic acid, which gives yogurt and other fermented products their characteristic tangy flavor.
